protocol_config.purpose: Matched source/candidate behavior gate; not historical training reconstruction.

evaluation_runtime_source: explicit protocol JSON; checkpoint profiles are not inherited
protocol: Common early-checkpoint physics evaluation, not a reconstruction of historical training configuration. Model weights and each model's serialized observation normalizers are loaded; no optimizer or training update is executed. Deterministic default-pose reset with synchronized targets, no noise or pushes, fixed 10 ms delay. 36 all-direction speed/braking cases per policy on 80m patches, 25s M-S-reverse-S-M.
